Marco (AE): FYI Prospect NorthBridge Analytics wants SSO/SCIM POC. Security wants EU-only data residency, BYOK, SCIM audit trail retention, and firm Dedicated pricing if reserved capacity required. Can SE/PS/sec triage?
Elena (Solutions Eng): Got it. Quick: do they need OIDC for SPAs or just SAML for legacy apps? Also SCIM scope: users+groups+custom attrs?
Marco (AE): They said SAML primary; OIDC nice-to-have. SCIM = full lifecycle + groups + custom attrs (employeeType/costCenter). Domain controls: multiple domains (northbridge.com, analytics.northbridge.eu) need verification and signup restriction.
Ibrahim (Pricing): To size Dedicated I need expected token/month and peak concurrency. Ballpark ok. If they want 99.9% SLA + reserved GPUs we need a monthly commit.
Clara (Security): From questionnaire: BYOK, key rotation policy, SOC2, pen-test, SIEM export, and field-level redaction for provisioning logs. We have SOC2 Type II, BYOK via customer KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure). Audit logs default retention 90d; can extend.
Elena (Solutions Eng): Tech checklist I'll share:
- SAML: supports HTTP-POST/Redirect, signed assertions, optional encrypted assertions (AES-256). We accept metadata XML. Example ACS: <AssertionConsumerService Location="https://eu.nb.redwood.example/sso/acs" Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST"/>
- SCIM: v2 with PATCH and incremental/delta sync. Example PATCH to add member:
PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/{id}
Content-Type: application/json
[ { "op": "add", "path": "members", "value": [{"value": "user-321"}] } ]
- Domain enforcement: tenant config `verified_domains: ["northbridge.com","analytics.northbridge.eu"]` and `signup_policy: verified_only`.
Elena (Solutions Eng): Default hosted rate-limit = 60 reqs/min per tenant; Dedicated can raise limits. We can emit SCIM provisioning events to their SIEM via S3 or syslog forwarder.
Ibrahim (Pricing): Preliminary pricing tiers for planning: small Dedicated (2x equiv) ~$11k/mo, medium (4x) ~$21k/mo, large (8x) ~$39k/mo. BYOK + EU region + extended audit retention are add-ons. Discounts for 12/24mo. I'll draft three committed scenarios once we get throughput.
Clara (Security): I'll prepare a one-pager: SOC2 link, BYOK integration steps, pen-test summary, and note about redaction options. If they want EU-only BYOK we should propose Dedicated in EU region or Private deploy (6-9 week ETA).
workspace-bot: POC workspace provisioned: https://console.redwood.example/tenancy/poc-northbridge (id: poc-nb-202408). Initial invite sent to poc@northbridge.com :white_check_mark:
Marco (AE): Planned kickoff Friday next week, 2-week POC, decision in 30 days. Owners: Elena = SE, Ibrahim = pricing, Clara = security. Can someone request Okta metadata + sample CSV of users/groups?
Elena (Solutions Eng): I'll post a tech appendix with SAML metadata template, SCIM attribute mapping example (include employeeType -> profile.employeeType), and group->role mapping snippet. Need their IdP metadata + CSV.
Ibrahim (Pricing): I'll include costs for Dedicated vs Private (EU) and an example commitment table.
Clara (Security): Uploading compliance pack and a short mitigation plan. If they need field redaction for SCIM logs we can enable it at ingestion and redact exports.
Marco (AE): Thanks team. I'll message their admin to upload metadata + CSV and confirm kickoff.
Elena (Solutions Eng): Quick config snippet for role mapping to share: {"groupName": "data-engineers", "mappedRole": "analytics:engineer"}.
Marco (AE): Great, moving to action items.
(threads end)
